description: Strassen und Wege is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Basel-Stadt. Der Datensatz beinhaltet das Mobilitätsnetz Basel-Stadt sowie die Strassennetzhierarchie des Kantons Basel-Stadt. Zusätzlich sind die Durchgangsstrassen nach Durchgangsstrassenverordnung aufgeführt: Autobahnen, Europastrassen, Hauptstrassen. In Riehen und Bettingen sind die Kantonsstrassen ausgeschieden. Coverage: Kanton Basel-Stadt. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Basel-Stadt. It offers 8 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPKG, HTML, OCTET. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
